Tattoo - Abstract Sleeve.description:
🖋️ Tattoos: Abstract Sleeve
A full or partial sleeve of abstract ink work — connected patterns covering a significant portion of one arm.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Tattoo - Abstract Sleeve.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: A cohesive non-emissive abstract sleeve across one established arm, fitted to its actual contours. Mix clean geometric shapes and open negative space; keep natural markings legible and omit text, faction emblems and magical sigils.

Visual selection only: fit it to compatible visible surfaces; never invent limbs, horns, ears or other anatomy. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features. It adds no Quirk effect, item, protection, license or history.
